Keep the same four tiles, operand loads, reduction order, predicates, stores, transpose, and fallback. Check candidate assembly under the fixed flags, full-GEMM correctness at tolerance 0.002 including odd tails and n<=0, and fresh repeated paired AC timings against unchanged controls. risks: Compiler may restore the original order, or the new order may not improve scheduling and could regress throughput. The historical scores are noisy and do not establish this schedule's effect. Do not attribute any joint outcome to this proposal alone.
